sections.title: Introduction & inquiries
sections.content:
VietVoice is a Vietnamese Text-to-Speech (TTS) platform using AI, combining VieNeu-TTS (system voice), viXTTS (emotion), RVC (voice adjustment) and personal voice clone.

Main features

Features Description
Basic TTS System voice from DB library + your clone voice
Emotional TTS Emotional voice (viXTTS), Vietnamese tag in text
Voice Clone 3 modes: RVC, Zero-shot, viXTTS Clone
RVC after conversion Pitch / Index / Protect on the created WAV file
Export audio WAV, MP3, OGG — bitrate 64–320 kbps
Library Save, find, name, share link publicly
Multilingual VI/EN interface; many pages of self-translated content
Theme Light / dark mode (save localStorage)

User Requirements

Item Details
Browser Chrome, Edge, Coc Coc, Firefox (new versions)
Connection Stable Internet to VietVoice server
Account Sign up for email or Google (one email = one account)
Android app Android 6.0+ (Web-wrapped WebView)

Default URL (local)

Page URL
Workspace (logged in) http://127.0.0.1:5000/
Landing (not logged in yet) http://127.0.0.1:5000/landing
Sign in /login
Register /register

sections.title: Register, log in & secure your account
sections.content:
2.1 Register (/register)

POST JSON with fields:

School Request
username No duplicates, no accents
email Valid, not duplicate
password Minimum 6 characters
full_name Display name
accept_terms Required — agree to the terms

After successful registration:

  • Create record user_subscriptions: 100,000 characters, duration 30 days
  • Switch back to login page

2.2 Login (/login)

  • Enter username or email + password
  • Or Sign in with Google (/auth/google)

New Google account: Create your own user, assign 100,000 characters / 30 days, save google_id and Google avatar.

Login session: Save 24 hours (PERMANENT_SESSION_LIFETIME = 86400).

Account disabled / deleted: Login blocked with error code i18n (account_deactivated_grace, account_deleted, …).

2.3 Forgot password (/forgot-password)

  1. Enter registered email → send request
  2. Server sends email containing reset link (requires SMTP configuration on server)
  3. Link is valid 1 hour (PASSWORD_RESET_EXPIRY_HOURS = 1)
  4. Open link → /reset-password/<token> → enter new password (≥ 6 characters)

Sign in on multiple devices:

  • Email may require phone confirmation (/reset-password/confirm/<token>)
  • Frontend poll status via /api/forgot-password/status/<wait_id>

2.4 Sign out

/logout — delete session, switch back to /login.

sections.title: Workspace — Text-to-speech
sections.content:
Workspace is a / page with 3 input tabs:

Tab Description
Enter text Type / paste directly
Upload file TXT, PDF, DOCX
Emotional TTS viXTTS + emotion tags

4.1 Text Input Tab

  1. Type or paste text — realtime character count
  2. Warn if many Latin (non-Vietnamese) characters are detected
  3. Select voice in dropdown System voice or My voice
  4. Click Convert now → POST /api/convert

Body API:

{ "text": "...", "voice_id": "Binh" }

or "voice_id": "custom_123" for clone voice.

Default if not selected: voice Binh / BinhHM.

4.2 File Upload Tab

Format Handling
.txt Read in browser (client)
.pdf, .docx POST /api/upload/extract — server extracts text
  • Configuration limit: 10 MB (MAX_FILE_SIZE in config.py)
  • PDF scan/image not supported — only text layer
  • Extracted text automatically fills in the input box (and Emotional tab if available)

4.3 Voice Gallery — Listen to the audition

  • The Listen button opens the modal #voiceGalleryModal
  • Data from GET /api/voices
  • Each accent: description, region, gender icon
  • Sample: /static/voice-samples/{voice_id}_sample.wav (if has_sample)
  • Select this voice → update dropdown

Admin can create samples: POST /api/admin/generate-voice-samples.

4.4 Voice clone in dropdown

  • ID format: custom_<id> (id is a number in the custom_voices table)
  • Voice only status = completed
  • Display quality score (stars) if available
  • URL /?custom_voice=<id> choose your own voice when opening the page

4.5 Character limit when converting

  • Each conversion subtracts len(text) from user_subscriptions.characters_remaining
  • No hard limit per request — only limited by package
  • Default free: 100,000 characters / 30 days
  • Out of quota → error "You have reached the limit of characters..."

4.6 Result after conversion

  • Player listens inline — stream GET /api/audio/<filename>
  • Save file: audio_outputs/{uuid}.wav
  • conversions record — status completed / failed
  • audio name box (display_name, maximum 200 characters)
  • Panel Voice Control (RVC) — section 6
  • Select export format — item 7

sections.title: Emotional TTS (viXTTS)
sections.content:
Tab Emotional TTS — model viXTTS (~1.8 GB RAM when loaded).

5.1 Readiness Check

  • GET /api/emotional-tts/status → { ready, message }
  • Workspace poll every 5 seconds until ready = true
  • First time starting the server: load model 30–60 seconds

5.2 Convert emotions

POST /api/convert-emotional:

{ "text": "...", "custom_voice_id": 123 }
  • custom_voice_id (optional): indicates voice of type viXTTS Clone
  • Do not select → use default ref base_voice.wav + emotional ref

Billing: Except for basic TTS-like characters.

5.3 Emotion tags (Vietnamese)

The system detects emotions from tags in brackets (...) or keywords:

Emotions Tag / suggested keywords Ref audio
Cheerful (bright), (happy), (smile), haha cheerful_ref.wav
Excited (excited), (excited), (wow), awesome excited_ref.wav
Calm (slow), (warm), (gentle), (calm) calm_ref.wav
Sad (sad), (sorry), pain, hurt calm_ref.wav
Neutral No tags base_voice.wav

How to write with lots of emotion: Put the tag on a separate line before the paragraph:

(bright)
Good morning! The weather is so beautiful today!

(sad)
It's a pity that we have to part ways.

Text is chunked by emotion — each synth chunk is separate and then merged.

5.4 Emotional voice dropdown

  • List only viXTTS Clone voices (/api/custom-voices/list filter type)
  • Default: ref system voice

5.5 Notes

  • Emotional TTS does not use RVC panel after conversion (different pipeline)
  • Voice ID saved: viXTTS-Emotional or viXTTS-Emotional (voice name)
  • You should use < 500 charactersat a time for stability

sections.title: Voice adjustment after TTS (RVC)
sections.content:
After Basic TTS is successful, the Voice Adjustment panel appears.

POST /api/voice-conversion:

{
  "audio_filename": "abc.wav",
  "pitch": 0,
  "index_rate": 0.75,
  "protect": 0.33
}
Parameters Scope Default Meaning
pitch -12 … +12 0 Higher / lower
index_rate 0 … 1 0.75 Voice mixing
protect 0 … 0.5 0.33 Consonant protection

Quick preset on UI: Male→Female (+8), Female→Male (-8), Higher (+4), Lower (-4), Reset.

  • Do not subtract additional characters — only reprocess existing files
  • Need RVC (RVC_AVAILABLE) — GET /api/voice-conversion/check
  • Update conversions record with new file

Note: The RVC clone voice has pitch/speed applied at the conversion step — this panel is used for system TTS output.

sections.title: Export & download audio files
sections.content:
7.1 Format

GET /api/audio/formats returns:

  • formats: wav, mp3, ogg
  • bitrates: 64, 96, 128, 192, 256, 320 kbps (default 192)
  • ffmpeg: yes / no

7.2 Download

GET /api/audio/<filename>/export?format=mp3&bitrate=192

Format Request
WAV Always active — original file
MP3 / OGG Server needs ffmpeg in PATH

If ffmpeg is not available, UI fallback loads WAV.

7.3 Listen live

GET /api/audio/<filename> — requires login, streams WAV.

sections.title: Clone individual voices
sections.content:
8.1 Three clone modes

Type (voice_type) Sample duration Training Use in
RVC (rvc) 30 s – 15 minutes (900 s) Background worker 1–5 minutes Basic TTS (base voice + pitch/speed)
Zero-shot (zero_shot) 30 s – 15 minutes Immediately (completed) Basic TTS (ref audio + ref_transcript)
viXTTS Clone (vixtts_clone) 6 s – 120 s (2 minutes) Immediately Basic TTS + Emotional TTS

Sample file formats: WAV, MP3, M4A (UI); The server accepts OGG, FLAC.

Quality suggestions: Quiet room, no background music, stable mic 15–20 cm; viXTTS Clone should be 10–60 seconds clear.

8.2 Add voice (/add-voice)

Sending form POST /api/custom-voice/upload (multipart):

School Description
voice_name Display name
description Options
audio_file Sample file
voice_type rvc / zero_shot / vixtts_clone
base_voice_id RVC: background voice (default ly)
pitch_adjustment RVC: int
speed_adjustment RVC: float (default 1.0)
energy_adjustment RVC: float (default 1.0)
ref_transcript Required with Zero-shot — text matches audio

viXTTS Clone: Need Emotional TTS model ready on server.

8.3 Voice management (/my-voices)

  • 9 voices/page, URL pagination ?page=
  • Test: POST /api/custom-voice/<id>/test — test text max 300 characters
  • RVC progress: GET /api/custom-voice/<id>/progress — status, progress, error
  • Delete: DELETE /api/custom-voice/<id>/delete
  • Status: pending → processing → completed / failed

8.4 Use clone voice

  • Dropdown Workspace: prefix custom_<id>
  • Emotional: only vixtts_clone in separate dropdown
  • Usage recorded voice_usage_logs

sections.title: Price list & character limit
sections.content:
Page: /pricing (login required)
Packages API: GET /api/packages

11.1 Default package (can be replaced by Admin)

Package Character Price (VND) Duration
Free Plan 100,000 0 30 days
Basic Plan 1,500,000 500,000 30 days
Standard Plan 4,000,000 1,000,000 30 days
Premium Plan 10,000,000 2,000,000 30 days
Enterprise Plan 27,000,000 5,000,000 30 days

Admin adjust package: Admin → Site Configuration → Package or API /api/admin/packages.

11.2 How to calculate limit

  • Sign up / New Google: 100,000 characters, 30 days
  • Buy package: Add characters_limit package to subscription; extend end_date by adding duration_days
  • Display: Navbar badge + Profile + GET /api/user/characters

11.3 Personal payment history

GET /api/user/payments?page=1&per_page=8 (per_page 5–50)

sections.title: SePay payment & bills
sections.content:
12.1 Payment Flow

  1. /pricing → select package → Upgrade
  2. POST /api/payment/create { "package_id": N }
  3. Create payments — status pending, transaction_id = TTS + 16 hex characters (Example: TTSA1B2C3D4E5F67890)
  4. Go to /payment/confirm?id=<payment_id> — display QR VietQR
  5. Bank transfer — CK content must contain transaction_id
  6. Confirmed via:
  7. SePay Webhook: POST /api/payment/sepay/webhook
  8. Polling frontend: GET /api/payment/status/<payment_id> (~5 seconds)
  9. Success → update subscription now

SePay transaction matching: Content contains code + amount ≥ 99% package amount.

SePay Timeout: SEPAY_TIMEOUT default 300 seconds (5 minutes).

12.2 Remittance notes

  • Wrong content → system does not recognize itself
  • Waiting too 10 minutes → contact support + receipt photo + transaction_id

12.3 PDF Invoice

After successful payment: download /invoice/<payment_id>
File: VietVoice_Invoice_VV-{id:05d}.pdf (reportlab).

sections.title: Profile, avatar & account deletion
sections.content:
Page: /profile

13.1 Information & avatar

Action API / limitations
Update full name POST /api/user/update-profile
Upload avatar POST /api/user/upload-avatar — JPG/PNG/WebP, max 2 MB → /uploads/avatars/user_{id}.ext
Change password POST /api/user/change-password — MK old + new ≥ 6 characters
Statistics Total conversions, characters used
Current Package Package name, expiration, remaining characters

13.2 Account deletion request

  1. POST /api/user/request-account-deletion — optional reason (≤ 2000 characters)
  2. delete_status → pending; admin notification email
  3. Admin browses at Admin → Request to delete account

After admin approval:

  • is_active = 0, status = deactivated
  • Grace period 30 days (ACCOUNT_DELETION_GRACE_DAYS)
  • In grace: not logged in; can recover via public form
  • After 30 days: status = deleted (permanent)

Restore: POST /api/public/request-account-restore (email) → admin Restore at dashboard.

Status: GET /api/user/account-deletion-status

sections.title: Android application
sections.content:
Flutter WebView app (app_web_view/) wraps the entire web.

16.1 Install APK

  1. Receive app-release.apk from the developer
  2. Turn on Install from unknown source
  3. Install and open the app

16.2 Server configuration

File app_web_view/lib/config.dart:

  • webBaseUrl / apiBaseUrl — Server URL (no trailing /)
  • Emulator: http://10.0.2.2:5000
  • Real device: IP LAN server (Example: http://192.168.1.x:5000)

16.3 Sign in to Google on app

  • OAuth via Chrome Custom Tab
  • Callback scheme: petai → petai://callback?mobile_token=...
  • Token mobile TTL 5 minutes → /auth/mobile/callback

16.4 Features

  • Like a full web browser
  • usesCleartextTraffic="true" for HTTP local — off for HTTPS production

sections.title: Advanced tips
sections.content:
17.1 Choose your voice according to your purpose

Purpose Suggestion
Stories, novels Northern and Southern accent, slow speed
News Southern female
Creative Podcast Emotional — Cheerful / Excited
Meditation, relaxation Emotional — Calm
“My” voice viXTTS Clone + Emotional tags

17.2 Writing text for trainees

  • Full punctuation — determines rhythm
  • Segmentation < 2000 charactersper request
  • Numbers are written in words when pronouncing them correctly
  • Abbreviations should be explained first

17.3 Saving quota

  • Reuse Library files — do not convert again
  • Test the short paragraph first
  • Name the file to find it quickly

17.4 Quality voice clone

  • RVC / Zero-shot: 30–60 seconds multi-tonal reading
  • viXTTS Clone: 10–60 seconds, no noise
  • Zero-shot: ref_transcript must match audio content

sections.title: Handling common errors
sections.content:
Error / situation Cause How to handle
Out of character quota characters_remaining < len(text) Upgrade /pricing
Loading Emotional model viXTTS is not ready Wait 30–60 seconds; see /api/emotional-tts/status
Server not responding Flask is not running / network Check http://127.0.0.1:5000
Upload text file error > 10 MB or wrong format Use TXT or split
PDF without text PDF scan/image External OCR or manual copy
Clone RVC failed Audio < 30s or noise Record 30–60 seconds, quiet
viXTTS Clone is too short/long Beyond 6–120s Cut/edit sample file
Zero-shot error Missing ref_transcript Enter transcript to match audio
No packet received after CK Incorrect CK content Send support: transaction_id + photo
Do not receive MK reset email SMTP not configured Contact admin
RVC panel not showing RVC_AVAILABLE = false Contact admin to install RVC/faiss
MP3/OGG does not load No ffmpeg Download WAV or install ffmpeg
Login blocked grace Account is being deleted for 30 days Recovery or contact admin form
EN not displayed Cache / Error Translation API Transfer VI; admin checks OpenAI

sections.title: Architectural overview
sections.content:
VietVoice is Flask monolith (web/app.py) serving:

  • Frontend: Jinja2 templates + Tailwind (CDN) + vanilla JS (index.js, i18n.js)
  • Basic TTS: VieNeu-TTS (VieNeu-TTS-main/main.py)
  • Emotional TTS: viXTTS (emotional_tts_vixtts.py, model ~1.8 GB)
  • Voice clone: RVC training (voice_training.py, background_worker.py), Zero-shot, viXTTS Clone
  • Post-process: RVC pitch (rvc_wrapper.py), export (audio_export.py + ffmpeg)
  • DB: MySQL tts_system — users, conversions, voices, payments, custom_voices
  • CMS: JSON files + 2 Markdown guide files (do not save guide in DB)
  • Mobile: Flutter WebView (app_web_view/) + OAuth deep link petai://

Basic TTS request flow:

Client POST /api/convert
  → check login + character quota
  → INSERT conversions (processing)
  → VieNeu / viXTTS clone / zero_shot / RVC custom
  → WAV → audio_outputs/
  → UPDATE conversions (completed) + deduct characters_used

sections.title: Directory structure
sections.content:
Note the path:Your repo is usually located in
...\LUANVAN (2) - Copy\LUANVAN (2) - Copy\ (workspace).
The main code directory is LUANVAN/ inside — config.py consider it BASE_DIR (parent of web/).

<workspace>/ # EXAMPLE: LUANVAN (2) - Copy\LUANVAN (2) - Copy\
├── LUANVAN/ #BASE_DIR — father of the web/

│ │ ├── app.py # Entry point (~7900 lines)

sections.title: MySQL & schema
sections.content:
5.1 Create database

Database name: tts_system (config.DB_NAME).

Run SQL in order:

# File Main content
1 tts_database.sql users, conversions, voices, sessions, statistics
2 custom_voices_schema.sql custom_voices, training_queue, voice_usage_logs
3 payment_schema.sql subscription_packages, user_subscriptions, payments
4 custom_voices_update_v2.sql pitch/speed/energy_adjustment, base_voice_id
5 custom_voices_zero_shot.sql voice_type, ref_transcript 
cd LUANVAN/database
mysql -u root -p < tts_database.sql
mysql -u root -p < custom_voices_schema.sql
mysql -u root -p < payment_schema.sql
mysql -u root -p < custom_voices_update_v2.sql
mysql -u root -p < custom_voices_zero_shot.sql

Or Windows: run LUANVAN\database\RUN_ALL_CREATE_DATABASE.bat

5.2 Default Admin

Field Value
username admin
password admin123

Change your password immediately after deploying.

5.3 Migration runtime (run_db_migrations())

Run automatically every time app.py starts:

Table users: column delete account, grace period, delete_status, …

Table conversions:

  • display_name VARCHAR(200)
  • is_public TINYINT
  • share_token VARCHAR(64) + index

Table password_reset_tokens: create if not available.

5.4 Important tables

Table Purpose
users Account, role (admin/user), OAuth, deletion state
conversions All TTS jobs + audio library rows
voices System preset voices for /api/voices
custom_voices User clones (voice_type, status, paths)
user_subscriptions characters_limit, characters_used, end_date
subscription_packages Pricing tiers (admin editable)
payments SePay transactions, transaction_id
voice_usage_logs Custom voice usage tracking
training_queue RVC training jobs

5.5 Default plan (payment_schema.sql)

package_name characters_limit price_vnd duration_days
Free Plan 100,000 0 30
Basic Plan 1,500,000 500,000 30
Standard Plan 4,000,000 1,000,000 30

sections.title: SePay & payments
sections.content:

12.2 Payment flow

POST /api/payment/create { package_id }
  → transaction_id = "TTS" + uuid.hex[:16].upper()
  → payments.status = pending
  → QR via img.vietqr.io or manual EMV QR
User transfers with transaction_id in content
  → POST /api/payment/sepay/webhook
  → OR GET /api/payment/status/<id> (poll + auto verify)
  → update_user_subscription(): add chars + extend end_date

12.3 SePay matching logic

  • transaction_content contains transaction_id (normalized alphanumeric)
  • Amount ≥ 99% of amount_vnd

12.4 Admin payment tools

  • POST /api/admin/payment/approve — manual approval

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.content:
ModuleNotFoundError: flask / pymysql

venv310\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt

Can't connect to MySQL

  • XAMPP MySQL running / systemctl status mysql
  • Check .env.local DB_* values
  • Database name must be tts_system

Unknown column is_public / display_name

Restart server — run_db_migrations() auto-adds.

Emotional TTS not ready

  • Check web/vixtts_model/ complete
  • RAM ≥ 4 GB
  • Wait for log [viXTTS] ✅ Model ready!

viXTTS clone upload rejected

  • Duration must be 6–120 seconds
  • Emotional model must be loaded

RVC clone upload rejected

  • Duration 30–900 seconds via audio_processor.validate_audio()

Zero-shot error on upload

  • ref_transcript required
  • Run custom_voices_zero_shot.sql migration if column missing

MP3/OGG export fails

ffmpeg -version

Email not sent (reset password / deletion)

  • Configure SMTP in .env.local
  • Gmail: App Password + SMTP_USE_TLS=1
  • Set APP_BASE_URL for correct reset links

EN content stale

Delete cache files: legal_content_en.json, support_content_en.json, landing_content_en.json

Or change VI content to invalidate hash.

Guide page not updated

  • Edit web/USER_GUIDE.md (not copy elsewhere)
  • pip install markdown
  • Hard refresh browser

Port 5000 in use (Windows)

netstat -ano | findstr :5000
taskkill /PID <pid> /F

Google OAuth redirect mismatch

URI must match exactly — no trailing slash:

http://localhost:5000/auth/google/callback

SePay payment not detected

  • Transfer content must include full transaction_id (e.g. TTSA1B2C3...)
  • Amount must match ≥ 99%
  • Check SEPAY_TOKEN and webhook URL reachable

sections.title: Our commitment
sections.content:
VietVoice respects your rights to personal data. You have the right to request deletion of all data related to your account at any time, in accordance with the requirements of Google Play, Apple App Store and data protection regulations.

✅ We process all data deletion requests within 30 days of receipt of the request.

sections.title: The data will be deleted
sections.content:
When you request to delete your account, we will permanently delete:

  1. Account information: email, full name, encrypted password
  2. Text-to-speech conversion history
  3. Created and stored audio files
  4. Uploaded voice files for cloning
  5. Trained personal voice data
  6. Payment and transaction history
  7. Personal settings and preferences
⚠️ Once deleted, audio files on your personal device still need to be manually deleted if you downloaded them.

sections.title: How to request data deletion
sections.content:
You can request data deletion in the following ways:

  1. Via email: Send an email to danhvt388@gmail.com with the subject "Data deletion request" and account email address
  2. Via contact page: Fill out form at Contact page with account deletion request.
  3. In the application: Go to Personal profile → Account deletion request clause.
📧 Submit data deletion request now

After receiving the confirmation request, all data will be deleted from the system within 30 days.

Handling process:

  2. In 7 day: Delete personal data from main system
  3. Within 30 days: Delete from backup and backup storage systems

sections.title: Introduce
sections.content:
These payment terms describe how you pay for VietVoice service packages, accepted methods, confirmation process and refund policy.

💳 Payments are processed through the SePay portal — bank transfer or QR code scanning.

sections.title: Payment method
sections.content:
VietVoice currently supports:

  • Bank transfer — via the account displayed at checkout
  • Scan QR code — open the banking app and scan the code on the payment page

⚠️ Only pay according to the amount and transfer content displayed on the confirmation page. Transferring the wrong amount or wrong code may delay package activation.

sections.title: Price and service package
sections.content:
Package prices are listed on the Price List page and may change over time. The price includes the character limit per package and term of use (usually 30 days/period).

After successful payment, the character limit is added to your account according to the selected package.

sections.title: Payment confirmation
sections.content:
After you transfer the correct information:

  • The system automatically checks the transaction via SePay (usually within a few minutes)
  • You can click Check now on the payment page if necessary
  • When successfully confirmed, the package is activated and the number of characters is added immediately

ℹ️ If the package has not been added after 30 minutes, please Please contact danhvt388@gmail.com with transaction code.

sections.title: Refund policy
sections.content:
You can request a refund within 3 days from the date of payment if:

  • The service does not work as described on the Price List page
  • Technical error from VietVoice makes it impossible to use the service

⚠️ Refunds do not apply when more than 50% of the package's character limit has been used, or in violation Terms of use.

Send a refund request to danhvt388@gmail.com with account email and transaction code.

sections.title: Package renewal and cancellation
sections.content:
Paid packages do not automatically renew — you need to proactively purchase a new package when it expires or the character limit expires.

We do not save payment card information on the VietVoice system.
